Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. Offers Having Common Internet Protocol (IP) Address: Bidders shall note that the bid submissio n portal (GeM) captures and displays the Internet Protocol (IP) address from which the bidder has submitte d the bid. The received bids, having matching/common IP address of bidders shall be outrightly rejected a nd shall not be considered for further evaluation. 7). Submission Of Requisite Documents: The Successful Bidders are requested to submit the requisite documents as per the Contract well in advance of the dispatch of the first consignment. 8). Participation of Manufacturer and Authorized Dealer/Agent: Either the manufacturer or its Auth orized Dealer/Agent may submit a bid for the same product, but both shall not submit bids for the same pr oduct of the same brand and under the same product name in the same tender. If both the manufacturer a nd its Authorized Dealer/Agent submit bids for the same product of the same brand and under the same pr oduct name, only the bid submitted by the manufacturer shall be considered for further evaluation. The bi d submitted by the Authorized Dealer/Agent for the same product shall not be considered. 9). MSE Purchase preference: If any of the SC/ST vendors fall within L1 + 15%, the entire 25% preferen ce earmarked for MSE vendor will be placed on SC/ST vendors, irrespective of their price ranking among M SEs subject to bringing down of price to L1 by the SC/ST vendors concerned. 10). Mandatory Submission and Verification of OEM Authorization to Sell on GeM / ADC. 1. The bidder shall submit the OEM Authorization to Sell on GeM along with the offer. The authorization shall contain the required information as specified in the prescribed format attached to the Buyer U ploaded ATC document and shall be duly signed by the OEM. 2. If the bidder already has a valid Authorized Dealership Certificate (ADC) and submits the same inste ad of the OEM Authorization to Sell on GeM, the ADC may be considered for technical evaluation. 3. The buyer may verify the OEM Authorization to Sell on GeM or ADC with the OEM/Principal, wherever required. 4. The document submitted by the bidder shall be considered subject to technical evaluation and furth er consideration. 11). Test Certificate: 1. The successful bidder shall submit the required Test Certificate(s), as specified in the ATC, along wit h the supplied material and within the stipulated delivery period. 2. The delivery shall be treated as complete only after the material and the required Test Certificate(s) are received by NLCIL. 3. Note: Payments shall become due and payable to the bidder only after submission and acceptance of the Test Certificate(s). 12). General Guarantee for Warranty (GGW): 1. The General Guarantee for warranty shall be applicable for a period of 12 months from the date of c ommissioning or 18 months from the date of receipt of material at site, whichever is earlier, as per NLCIL format. 2. The successful bidder shall submit the GGW along with the supplied material, in the prescribed form at attached, on non-judicial stamp paper of value not less than Rs. 80/-, purchased in the name of th e seller, as per the applicable Stamp Act. 3. The delivery shall be treated as complete only after the material and the GGW are received by NLCI L. 4. Note:Payments shall become due and payable to the bidder only after submission and acceptance of the GGW by NLCIL. . 4.
